title: tdh.util.audioFile.ui~
description: `tdh.util.audioFile.ui~` is a flexible audio-file player with controls for loading, playing, stopping, looping, normalizing, and selecting playback start and end points in milliseconds; it can also load raw data files for data bending or sonification. Send a bang to play the stored file, and set playback speed from 0.1 to 500, where 100 is normal, lower values are faster, and higher values are slower.
